newValue.text: Market page can be closed during debrief

snapshot.title: Can't close market page
snapshot.description:
At a minimum, can't close it when in debrief page/modal

Also, the market shouldn't be available until the user unlocks the market, which allows them to sell materials on the open market (which will later be integrated into multiplayer features); this will be useful for custom missions.
On that, **a casual** reminder that custom missions may involve users collecting materials for their own use, or they may notice that a mineral they have the location of is at a peak height in valuation so may just decide to mine as much of it as possible.
Another thing - for future documentation...possibly users may want to take control of certain minerals or locations (e.g. blockades or "territory") - this may be something we explore doing in the future when we integrate it into the rest of the ecosystem, but not now.
